project.name: study-gcp-search-mlops-gke
project.purpose: Real-estate hybrid-search API + continuous-retraining MLOps loop on GCP/GKE: Elasticsearch BM25 + multilingual-e5 + Vertex AI Vector Search fused by RRF and reranked by LightGBM LambdaRank, with behaviour-log driven retraining orchestrated by Cloud Composer.

entrypoints.description: FastAPI app served on GKE Pod. Routes: /api/v1/search, /api/v1/feedback, /ops/*, /ui/*, /livez|/healthz|/readyz, /metrics.
KServe HuggingFace runtime container for multilingual-e5 embeddings (query/passage prefixes).
KServe custom-predictor container for LightGBM LambdaRank /predict + /explain (TreeSHAP).
KFP pipeline `property-search-train`: load_features → train_reranker → evaluate → register_reranker (gate).
KFP pipeline `property-search-embed`: load_properties → batch_predict_embeddings → write_embeddings → upsert_vector_search.
STUB KFP pipeline `property-search-evaluate` (no real components wired yet).
Aggregates impressions + user_actions into mlops.ranking_labels (weighted relevance).
Builds training_dataset.csv from ranker repository (offline dataset snapshot).
`train-reranker` CLI — LightGBM LambdaRank train, GCS upload, mlops.training_runs row.
Airflow DAG @ 01:00 JST: Dataform run → Feature View sync → (opt) VVS incremental backfill.
Airflow DAG @ 04:00 JST (CANONICAL retrain): check_retrain → submit train pipeline → wait → AUTO_PROMOTE gate → promote.
Airflow DAG @ 04:30 JST: feature_skew SQL + model_output_drift SQL + SLO burn-rate.
Apache Beam / Dataflow streaming job: ranking-log Pub/Sub → hourly CTR aggregation → BigQuery.
`make run-all-core` orchestrator (16-step canonical validation: readiness → seed → label → train → daily → accuracy).
`make deploy-all` orchestrator (15-step: tf-bootstrap → 2-stage tf apply → seed → sync-elasticsearch → composer-deploy-dags → deploy-api).
Cloud Function HTTP trigger that submits Vertex PipelineJobs (smoke/manual alt to Composer).

flows.name: hybrid_search_request

steps.action: Map SearchRequest → SearchInput, resolve request_id, depend on SearchService.
Emit search_event via EventWriter.
Embed query text → 768-dim ME5 vector.
Optional: expand lexical query via Redis dict (encoder side untouched).
run_search: retrieve, optional FOS feature fetch, rerank, publish ranking_log, sort.
Hybrid retrieval: ES BM25 + VVS ANN → RRF fuse → BQ feature JOIN.
BM25 search on Elasticsearch cluster.
Approximate-NN over the deployed VVS index.
Optional: fetch ctr/fav_rate/inquiry_rate via Vertex Feature View.
Build 10-column feature matrix (FEATURE_COLS_RANKER).
POST features → LightGBM /predict (or /predict_with_explain for TreeSHAP).
Publish ranking_log rows to `ranking-log` topic (best-effort).
Emit impressions per ranked item, attach popularity score, build SearchOutput.
Optional: BQML aux popularity scoring per property_id.
Publish search_events + search_impressions to Pub/Sub → mlops.* via BQ subscriptions.

failure_modes: encoder or retriever unset → 503 SearchServiceUnavailable
Elasticsearch / VVS transient errors propagate (5xx)
FOS fetch fails → degraded (rerank with stale BQ features, logged)
ranking_log publish fails → silent (logged, /search still serves)
BQML popularity scoring fails → continues without popularity column
Reranker timeout → propagates

flows.name: user_feedback_event
flows.trigger: HTTP POST /api/v1/feedback (from /ui/property/{id} buttons or programmatic clients)

steps.action: Bind FeedbackRequest → FeedbackService.
Emit user_action via EventWriter; if action in {click,favorite} also publish legacy feedback record.
Publish to `user-actions` Pub/Sub topic → mlops.user_actions BQ subscription.
Legacy: publish to `search-feedback` → mlops.feedback_events.

failure_modes: Pub/Sub publish failure → returns accepted=false (logged, not raised)
Schema drift between Pydantic ActionType and BQ enum could silently drop rows

flows.name: daily_feature_refresh

steps.action: DataformCreateCompilationResultOperator + DataformCreateWorkflowInvocationOperator.
Run Dataform: sources → staging → features → monitoring SQL refresh feature_mart.*.
Trigger Vertex AI Feature View sync (Feature Online Store refresh).
Optional (`ENABLE_DAILY_VVS_REFRESH=true`): incremental VVS index backfill.

failure_modes: Dataform compile/invocation failure halts Feature View sync
Feature View sync silently lags if quota throttled
VVS index backfill is opt-in; default off may diverge from BQ embeddings

flows.name: retrain_orchestration

steps.action: Read mlops.feedback_events / training_runs / accuracy report; decide should_retrain.
Compile + submit KFP `property-search-train` pipeline to Vertex AI Pipelines.
Pipeline runs: load_features (BQ JOIN) → train_reranker → evaluate (NDCG@10 gate) → register_reranker (conditional).
Inside train_reranker container: LightGBM LambdaRank fit, write artifacts, mlops.training_runs row.
Upload model.txt + metrics.json to gs://<artifacts>/models/.
evaluate → register_reranker: Vertex Model Registry upload + Endpoint traffic split (if gate passed).
Block until PipelineJob SUCCEEDED.
If AUTO_PROMOTE=true: alias newest version → `production`.

failure_modes: Empty ranking_labels frame → load_features fails (root cause: labeling job didn't run / ordering violation)
evaluate gate (NDCG@10 < threshold) skips registration but still consumes compute
Vertex traffic split misconfiguration could send 100% traffic to a regressed model
AUTO_PROMOTE=true without manual review = risk of bad alias flip

flows.name: monitoring_validation

steps.action: BigQueryInsertJobOperator runs validate_feature_skew.sql → mlops.validation_results.
BigQueryInsertJobOperator runs validate_model_output_drift.sql → mlops.model_monitoring_alerts.
Check SLO + burn-rate (Cloud Monitoring) and emit alerts.

failure_modes: SQL file path resolution: Composer data dir vs repo fallback (incident pattern)
Skew SQL false positives when feature distribution shifts seasonally
SLO definition decoupled from /metrics service label = silent SLO blindness

flows.name: labeling_pipeline
flows.trigger: CLI `python -m pipeline.labeling_job.main` (invoked by `make label-build` in run-all)

steps.action: Read mlops.search_impressions + mlops.user_actions since (now-window_days).
compute_label per (search_id, property_id): weighted ACTION_WEIGHTS → relevance + label_source.
Write RankingLabel rows to mlops.ranking_labels.

failure_modes: Stale window (no recent feedback) → empty labels → empty training frame downstream
Synthetic action injection (definitions/labeling/synthetic_actions.yaml) bypasses user_actions — could mask app-emit regressions

flows.name: property_embedding_refresh
flows.trigger: Manual: `python -m pipeline.data_job.main submit` (or future Composer DAG)

steps.action: load_properties (BQ → properties_cleaned slice).
batch_predict_embeddings (Vertex BatchPrediction on ME5).
write_embeddings (BQ feature_mart.property_embeddings upsert).
upsert_vector_search → Vertex Vector Search index (skip if index unset).

failure_modes: VVS index missing → upsert silently skipped (Strangler default-off)
Embeddings table and VVS index can diverge (no transactional coupling)
Batch prediction quota throttling extends pipeline wall time

flows.name: ranking_log_streaming_aggregation

steps.action: Source: ranking-log Pub/Sub topic (one msg per /search candidate).
Beam: 1h tumbling window → group by property_id → (impressions, clicks-synthesized-from-rank==1).
Sink: BigQuery mlops.ranking_log_hourly_ctr.

failure_modes: Clicks are synthesized from final_rank==1 (learning proxy, not real CTR) → biased training signal
Streaming pipeline restart loses in-flight windows unless checkpointed
BQ schema drift in hourly table breaks sink

flows.name: check_retrain_smoke
flows.trigger: HTTP POST /ops/jobs/check-retrain (Composer task + Cloud Scheduler monthly smoke + manual)

steps.action: Bind RetrainQueries via DI.
evaluate(feedback_rows, ndcg_drift, last_run_at) → ShouldRetrain decision.
If should_retrain: publish to retrain-trigger topic (PubSubPublisher) — best-effort.

failure_modes: Cannibalization risk: if Cloud Scheduler set to high-frequency cron it duplicates Composer retrain (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable)
Pub/Sub publish failure → published=false in response

flows.name: deploy_all_canonical

steps.action: 15 steps: tf-bootstrap → tf apply stage A → tf apply stage B → seed-minimal-clean → sync-elasticsearch → composer-deploy-dags → build-all-local → push images → deploy-api → configmap-overlay → kserve models → checkpoints.
Provision GKE/Composer/Vertex/Pub/Sub/Dataform/Cloud Domains.
Apply kustomize overlay: ES, KServe, search-api Gateway, NetworkPolicies.
Sync DAGs + SQL to Composer GCS bucket.

failure_modes: deploy/destroy-only callsites are NOT exercised by `make check` (incident: 5 latent bugs surfaced only via deploy-all)
Two-stage tf apply means partial-apply state on stage A failure
Composer Gen 3 auto-sets GCP_PROJECT — user-set PROJECT_ID can cause HTTP 400

swappable_backends: semantic: Vertex Vector Search (single canonical impl; Port left for future ES-ANN / OpenSearch swap)
reranker: KServe-hosted LightGBM (single impl; explainer optional)
feature fresh: Vertex Feature Online Store ↔ off (BQ-only)
event writer: Pub/Sub canonical ↔ CloudLogging fallback ↔ Noop
training experiment tracker: Vertex Experiments ↔ Null
vector search write: Vertex VVS ↔ InMemory (tests)

risks.issue: CloudLoggingEventWriter is bootstrap-only fallback. If left enabled in prod (3 topics unconfigured), event tables silently stay empty — entire retrain loop degrades to synthetic-only without obvious surface signal.

ml.streaming.pipeline synthesizes `click` from final_rank==1 instead of joining real /feedback. Hourly CTR table is therefore biased — using it for training would close a feedback loop on the model's own ranking.
Cloud Scheduler retains /jobs/check-retrain trigger. CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids it from acting as a parallel scheduler (would double-fire retrain).
pipeline.evaluation_job.main and pipeline.batch_serving_job.main are KFP stubs with `del project_id` — they compile but do nothing. README/docs imply offline eval is wired.

ECK manifest is intentionally HTTP + anonymous superuser (learning mode). A contract test pins this state, so adding auth requires deliberate flip. RISK becomes prod-grade only if endpoint is exposed beyond GKE cluster.
`make check` excludes scripts/setup/* and scripts/domain/* callsites; deploy/destroy bugs only surface during real `make deploy-all` (5-bug incident in M-Wave8.6).

Adding a ranker feature requires synchronized edits in Dataform / build_ranker_features / FEATURE_COLS_RANKER / ranking_log.features in Terraform / validate_feature_skew.sql / Vertex Feature Group. Drift here would corrupt training-serving skew.
retrain_orchestration auto-aliases `production` whenever AUTO_PROMOTE=true regardless of human review — the eval gate is a single NDCG@10 threshold.
search_service.run_search swallows ranking_log publish failures (telemetry). A persistent Pub/Sub topic/IAM outage would silently void retraining data.
SearchBuilder.resolve_feature_fetcher fails loud at startup if FOS resource IDs are blank when enable_search=True — config drift here = no /search at all.
/ops/destroy-check + /ops/search-volume + /ops/runs-recent shell out to `bq` CLI from inside the FastAPI process (subprocess.run). Latency + crash mode is uncharacteristic for an API.
8 action_type values must stay aligned across Pydantic / Terraform / labeling YAML / labeling SQL / EventWriter Port / ranking_labels — only enforced by docs + tests, not by a generated schema.

Is the retrain-trigger Pub/Sub topic actually subscribed to anything in canonical mode, or is it dead-letter telemetry for the smoke endpoint?
ml/serving/adapters/kserve_predictor.py overlaps with app/services/adapters/kserve_*.py — which is canonical for non-app callers?
ml/streaming/ports + adapters look like scaffolding (single Dataflow adapter). Is the Port useful or premature abstraction?
scripts/ops/ops_router shells out to `bq` — should this migrate to BigQueryMetricsRepository or stay as an operator-only shortcut?
How is /readyz's `service` label kept in sync with the SLO good/total filter when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME changes per deploy?
